original: Stretched public budgets, squeezed between soaring debt costs and anaemic growth, have prompted growing numbers of young people, fearful that their prospects are fading, to lash out in countries where cash-strapped governments, struggling to keep their electoral promises, defray the rising cost of entrenched entitlements by incrementally watering down the social provisions on which the most vulnerable have come to depend.
shrunk: Tight public budgets, pressed between fast-rising debt costs and weak growth, have pushed growing numbers of young people, afraid that their prospects are fading, to fight back in countries where poor governments, struggling to keep their election promises, pay the rising cost of long-standing benefits by gradually cutting the social support on which the least protected have come to depend.

simple: Their debts cost more and more, and the economy is slow.
So, bit by bit, they cut help for poor and weak people.
Young people feel their future is getting worse.
So they get angry, and they fight back.
zh: 各国政府的预算本来就紧，债务开支还在猛涨，经济增长又乏力。为了兑现竞选承诺、承担越来越高的既有福利开支，一些政府只好逐步削减最缺乏保障的人赖以生活的社会支持。眼看前途越来越暗淡，越来越多的年轻人起来反抗。
context: 欧洲多国的财政压力与社会抗议。 · Public budgets and protests in Europe.
originalZh: 债务开支飙升、经济增长乏力，压得一些政府喘不过气。为了兑现竞选承诺、负担越来越高的既有福利开支，它们逐步削减弱势群体赖以生活的保障。越来越多的年轻人担心前途黯淡，奋起反抗。

simple: Scientists studied the ice for years.
They worried that warmer air could make the ice melt faster.
Many cities near the sea already have problems with floods.
The scientists said these cities could be in more danger than people thought.
zh: 研究冰盖多年的科学家担心，气温上升可能会加快冰盖融化。他们警告说，沿海城市面临的风险可能比先前估计的大得多，而其中许多城市已经在艰难应对洪水。
context: 冰盖融化与沿海城市的洪水风险。 · Melting ice and flood risks in seaside cities.
originalZh: 研究冰盖多年的科学家担心，升温会加快冰盖融化。他们警告，许多沿海城市已在疲于抗洪，而沿海城市面临的风险可能远超原先的估计。

simple: My grandmother grew up in this town.
The town looks very different now.
One family has had the little bread shop on the corner for fifty years.
The shop still sells the bread my grandmother loved when she was a child.
zh: 奶奶长大的小镇变了很多。街角那家小面包店还是那家人开的，已经开了五十年，如今还卖着她小时候爱吃的那种面包。
